subject.title: feat(ui): redesign cron page as sidebar-first Automations master-detail

question: Should upgrades preserve every valid persisted sidebar selection, or migrate the exact prior default `["overview"]` to include Automations?
rationale: The stored value does not distinguish an untouched old default from an intentional identical customization, so code alone cannot select the upgrade contract safely.

options.title: Preserve Persisted Pins
options.body: Apply the new pin only to fresh or invalid settings, avoiding any rewrite of existing valid user preferences.

options.title: Migrate Exact Old Default
options.body: Rewrite the exact prior default to include Automations, accepting that users who intentionally selected only Overview will also change.

options.title: Keep Existing Default
options.body: Ship the redesign and rename without adding Automations to the default pinned set.

recommendation.title: Preserve Persisted Pins
recommendation.body: Apply the new pin only to fresh or invalid settings, avoiding any rewrite of existing valid user preferences.

likelyOwner.reason: The paired product proposal and current-main history make this the strongest available owner for the navigation direction.
